summary: This informational document collects situations where wireless networks must behave with the reliability and predictability of wired ones, yet wires are not practical. Examples include aeronautical communications, amusement parks, industrial applications, pro audio and video, gaming, drone and vehicle control, edge robotics, and emergency vehicles. It supports the Reliable and Available Wireless work.

eli5.summary: Wires are dependable, but some things move around too much to use them. This is a list of jobs, like robots and rides, that need wireless that works every single time.

questions: reliable and available wireless use cases
